subtitle_lines: Each composition brought to life from rare ingredients
and the intuition of a France-trained perfumer.

quote_lines: Every scent is made by one pair of hands.

atelier.label: The Atelier
atelier.text: In a quiet studio in central Chișinău, every fragrance is composed by hand, from first sketch to final bottle. No factory lines. No shortcuts. Just patience, intuition, and extraordinary ingredients.

about.label: The Perfumer
about.text1: In a quiet atelier in Chișinău, raw materials become memories. Elena studied the art of perfumery in France, and each creation begins as an intuition: a fleeting image, a half-remembered place, a texture of light. And is slowly composed into something you can wear on your skin.
about.text2: Aromo Atelier was born from the belief that perfumery is an intimate art, not an industry. Every bottle is handcrafted in small batches, using carefully sourced ingredients from growers and distillers who share our reverence for the natural world.
about.text3: There are no mass campaigns here. No celebrity endorsements. Just a perfumer, a collection of extraordinary materials, and the patience to let each composition find its own truth.

fleur-sauvage.subtitle: Wild Iris · Violet Leaf · Musk
fleur-sauvage.description: Wildflowers gathered at dawn, still heavy with dew. Iris petals unfold into a bed of violet leaves and clean musk. An ode to untamed beauty.

noir-de-chisinau.subtitle: Oud · Amber · Tobacco Leaf
noir-de-chisinau.description: A midnight walk through the old quarter. Dark oud meets sun-dried tobacco, softened by a warm amber embrace. For those who carry mystery like a second skin.

lumiere-doree.subtitle: Saffron · Honey · Sandalwood
lumiere-doree.description: Golden hour, captured. Precious saffron threads dissolve into wild honey, resting on a foundation of creamy sandalwood. Light made tangible.

pierre-et-mousse.subtitle: Vetiver · Oakmoss · Wet Stone
pierre-et-mousse.description: Rain on ancient stone. Vetiver roots grip the earth while oakmoss softens every edge. A perfume that smells like stillness itself.

jardin-secret.subtitle: Rose · Fig Leaf · Black Tea
jardin-secret.description: A walled garden no one else knows about. Damask rose entwined with fig leaves, a cup of black tea cooling on the stone bench. Private beauty.

brume-de-mer.subtitle: Sea Salt · Driftwood · Neroli
brume-de-mer.description: Mediterranean mist at first light. Sea salt crystals on sun-bleached driftwood, neroli blossoms carried by the breeze. Freedom in a bottle.

ambre-eternel.subtitle: Amber · Labdanum · Vanilla
ambre-eternel.description: Ancient resins warmed by skin. Pure amber and labdanum swirl into Madagascar vanilla, creating a scent that feels like it has always existed.

feuille-verte.subtitle: Basil · Galbanum · Lemon Verbena
feuille-verte.description: An herb garden in late spring. Crushed basil and sharp galbanum cut through with sparkling lemon verbena. Clean energy, bottled.
